dst: scaled block slots inside the corner-marked frame d
match_cond: d.scale is the common in-frame square size; choose the unique offset where every existing square block in d aligns to a same-colored cell of s
transform: crop to the frame and paint each non-bg cell of s as a solid scale-by-scale block, preserving the frame corners
grid_shape: crop to the rectangle marked by the four corner pixels
symbol_instructions: external miniature pattern encodes the full block layout and colors
